messages.subject: [GSoC-R] First Evaluation
parts:
Mentors and Students:

I hope everyone has had a great first month of coding. Many of the
projects I am more closely involved with are deeply into their plans, a
few have adjusted scope a bit, but overall the work that I've seen so
far is very exciting.

The first evaluation period is open.

Evaluations will close on Friday. Please get your evaluations done as
soon as possible. Google's deadlines are firm, there are no
extensions. If your mentor evaluations are not complete on Friday
morning, I will fail your student for lack of mentor involvement.
Organizations are penalized for not completing evaluations.

Students: you will not get paid if you don't fill out your evaluation.
I can't see those evaluations, so I can't give you any more guidance
than to make sure that you get it done.

If either students or mentors have questions or problems,please bring
them to Toby's and my attention as soon as possible! We will do
everything we can to help.

Regards,

Brian
